status: Project terminology and editorial preferences. Not the ASD dictionary.

terms.meaning: Software that uses a model and tools to perform tasks.
The application that runs an agent, such as OpenClaw or Codex.
A group of related agent messages and actions recorded by a runtime.
A unit of input or output processed by a model. It is not always a whole word.
The AI system that processes input and produces output for an agent.
A function an agent can call to read information or perform an action.
One recorded action or state change. It is not necessarily a model call.
One registered ClawMetry installation. Use machine when the distinction is not relevant.
The background process that collects agent data and owns the local data store.
A collected view of recorded data at a specified time.
A record of related operations that shows their order and duration.
One operation in a trace, with its recorded start and end.
A periodic status message. Its absence does not prove that the agent stopped.
A notification that a monitored condition occurred.
A decision that permits a requested action. It is separate from an alert.
A declared rule that specifies when ClawMetry records or takes an action.
An approximate value calculated from stated inputs. It is not a confirmed bill.
One result in a data table. A result row can summarize many events.
An interface through which software exchanges requests and results.
A command-line interface.
A scheduled task or the service that runs scheduled tasks. Prefer scheduled task in explanations.
Transform data so that a key is required to read its contents.
Use a key to recover the contents of encrypted data.

preferred_words.leverage: use (when describing use of a feature)
preferred_words.simply: remove the word or explain the required step
